page.layout: One printed page, verse throughout. Upper block of roman verse at full width; below a rule, a centred heading and an italic poem; a marginal note at the left beside the poem's first lines; a marginal catchword-like word at the lower right corner.

main_text.p: Tute virga mea & pedum, jehova, es:
Cur, si lethiferus eam per umbras,
Vllas, te duce me tuente larvas?
Tecum in secla domi tuae morabor.
main_text.head: LEONARTVS VVEISSIVS: Visus suaviter olens.

p.i: Tibi quas procul a domo profecto,
Quorum tu loca, facta et institută

page.notes: Marginal note at left, beside the poem's opening lines: "Patritius Augustanus, &c." Lower right corner word "Nomen" is a catchword-like word, placed in the margin. Several words in the italic poem are uncertain due to print quality (e.g. "Aviti", "institută", "cateriq;"). The heading line "LEONARTVS VVEISSIVS:" is set in small capitals.
